'''"Plug-Eye" Maygo''' was a muscular [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] who left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sanyassa IV]] when he was a youth. He found his way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]], where he took work as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and a prizefighter. He earned the nickname of "Plug-Eye" after an iron ball from a malfunctioning [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] became lodged in his left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] socket. When he arrived in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] Maygo was hired by the [[Kintan Gunrunners]]. His associates were the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Tu'rsc'yulir]] and his [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan strider]] called [[Kar'sylic]].<ref name="RFT" />
